title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Pomegranate Kiwi and Watermelon E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: This exquisite e-liquid from Rachael Rabbit is an exotic fusion of juicy watermelon and tangy pomegranate, balanced with lush notes of kiwi and refreshing ice. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
